scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint
scripts.test:rules: firebase --config firebase/firebase.json emulators:exec --only firestore,storage 'npx pnpm --filter @ada/firebase-tests test'
scripts.test:api: firebase --config firebase/firebase.json emulators:exec --only firestore 'npx pnpm --filter @ada/api test'
scripts.test:e2e: export PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk/bin:$PATH" && firebase --config firebase/firebase.json emulators:exec --only firestore,auth 'npx playwright test -c apps/dashboard/playwright.config.ts'
